# PresentMode

[Desktop](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Desktop` · enum

```csharp
public enum PresentMode
```

How finished frames reach the screen.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="vsync"></a>`VSync` | Paced to the display, with no tearing: the default. |
| <a name="mailbox"></a>`Mailbox` | As fast as frames are made, replacing any not yet shown, with no tearing, where the graphics driver supports it; otherwise [`VSync`](#vsync). |
| <a name="immediate"></a>`Immediate` | As fast as frames are made, with tearing, where the graphics driver supports it; otherwise [`VSync`](#vsync). |
